title: Triggers, focus and dismissal
description: A non-focusable span trigger receives tabIndex and a button role. Focus moves inside the panel, Tab stays contained and Escape returns it to the trigger. Source workspace addition; not yet published on npm.

title: Sizes
description: Enumerate the sm, md, lg and xl widths from modalVariantMap so the documentation and your application cannot drift apart.

title: Named-part customization
description: Apply local classes to stable named parts without replacing built-in states. Panel classes follow portalled content.
